title: Seed crackers with celery and ricotta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Ground almonds, seeds, egg, ricotta, celery, chives and lemon are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line at an everyday price, and 100g ground almonds and 100g seeds are not a treat purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a lined tray and an oven, and pressing out a seed dough is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: One egg binding 100g ground almonds and the seeds makes a workable sticky dough that crisps at 160°C fan in 20 to 25 minutes, and 250g ricotta with four celery sticks is a sensible snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Mixing, pressing out, chopping celery and chives and zesting a lemon fit in 20 minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, pepper is covered by 'Season', and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Four sticks of celery and their leaves make up much of the fresh, cool topping, which suits a July afternoon snack.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Nuts, seeds, egg, ricotta and celery make a satisfying, protein-rich snack of real food.
